claude_proposed_widenings.name: halfDamageOnSuccess flag on save_gate ActivationPhase
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Shatter deals half damage on a successful save. Effect = DamageEffect | NoneEffect cannot represent halved damage. Encoding onSuccess as none is false; encoding it as full damage is also false. A flag or new Effect variant is required before any save-for-half spell can be encoded honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 3d8 Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one

claude_proposed_widenings.name: creature_type_save_modifier on save_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Constructs have Disadvantage on the save. save_gate has no mechanism for creature-type-conditional roll modifiers. Secondary gap; single-unit pressure.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A Construct has Disadvantage on the save.
